itinerary: Day 0: Depart I-8 Markaz Islamabad 11:30 PM via Hazara Motorway
Day 1: Overnight drive; Lulusar, Babusar Pass; reach Sassi 5 PM, hotel
Day 2: Breakfast; 2hr jeep then 2-4hr trek to Kutwal Village, camp
Day 3: 2-3hr trek to Kutwal Lake; full day at lake, camp
Day 4: Kutwal Lake; optional Haramosh La basecamp; back to village
Day 5: Trek to jeep point; jeep to Sassi; drive to Chillas/Naran
Day 6: Breakfast; drive to Islamabad via Naran, arrive 6 PM
pros: Includes 4x4 jeep rental Sassi-to-Kutwal and back within the price
Private transport from Islamabad plus guide and standard meals included
Clear daily timings (arrival/departure hours) given for each day
Optional Haramosh La basecamp excursion built into Day 4
Both PKR (60,000) and USD ($750 foreigner) pricing published
cons: Kutwal Lake altitude not stated (no ~3300m reference)
Group discount mentioned but amount unspecified
Porters for personal luggage, evacuation and rescue excluded
Long overnight road approach (Day 0 departure) before any trekking
verdict: A fully itemised 6-day package with jeep, transport, guide and standard meals bundled at a clear PKR/USD price; the main gaps are an unspecified group discount and no stated lake altitude.
excludes: Personal-luggage porters, emergency evacuation/rescue, tips, personal expenses, anything not listed.

itinerary: Day 1: Breakfast Balakot; via Dassu/Besham/Chilas; reach Gilgit 5 PM
Day 2: Drive to Sassi; trek to Korophon; camp near Kutwalgah
Day 3: Steep climb to Kutwal Lake (4,200m); explore and camp
Day 4: Optional viewpoint hikes; photography; second night at lake
Day 5: Descend to Kutwalgah; trek to Sassi; drive Gilgit/Skardu
Day 6: Buffer day for delays; early drive Gilgit to Islamabad
pros: Two nights camped at Kutwal Lake for relaxed exploration
Built-in Day 6 buffer for weather or road delays
Flexible end point (return via Gilgit or Skardu)
Bonfire and basic first aid included
cons: Breakfast only; lunch and dinner are excluded
USD-only pricing ($700), no PKR rate for locals
Requires a group of 8-12 guests at quoted price
Lists lake at 4,200m, conflicting with the ~3,300m reference
verdict: A 6-day USD-priced trek with a generous two-night lake stay and a buffer day, but meal coverage is breakfast-only and the quoted price assumes a fairly large group.
excludes: Lunch and dinner, hotel extras (e.g. water), entry tickets, insurance/liability, unforeseen circumstances.

itinerary: Day 1: Depart Islamabad 10:30 PM via Hazara Motorway; reach Chillas 4 PM
Day 2: Breakfast; drive to Sassi; 2hr jeep then 2-4hr trek to Kutwal Village
Day 3: 2-3hr trek to Kutwal Lake; full day exploring lake
Day 4: Optional Haramosh La basecamp; return to Kutwal Village camp
Day 5: Trek to jeep point; jeep to Sassi; drive to Naran/Chillas
Day 6: Breakfast; drive to Islamabad via Naran, arrive 6 PM
pros: Tiered group discounts published (5% for 4+, 10% for 8+)
Three meals daily (breakfast, daypack, dinner) included
4x4 jeep rental Sassi-to-Kutwal and back included in price
Low base price of RS 60,000 per person
cons: Kutwal Lake altitude not specified on the page
Emergency costs from unforeseen circumstances not covered
Itinerary near-identical to Tour Rangers (likely shared template)
verdict: The most transparent of the PKR-priced options, with published group-discount tiers, three meals a day and clear payment terms at a low base price; only the lake altitude is missing.
excludes: Personal expenses, travel insurance, tips for guides/porters, any emergency cost from unforeseen circumstances.

itinerary: Day 1: Drive to Gilgit, hotel, briefing; 4x4 jeep to Sassi village
Day 2: Trek 4-5hr through pine forests to Iskere camp
Day 3: Climb 5-6hr to Kutwal Lake area (3,310m)
Day 4: Full rest/exploration day around Kutwal Lake
Day 5: Side trek and lake views; light optional hikes
Day 6: Descend 4-5hr downhill to Iskere camp
Day 7: Jeep pickup and return drive to Skardu
pros: Only operator stating Kutwal Lake altitude (~3,310m), matching brief
Longer 7-day pace with dedicated rest and side-trek days
Mentions trained porters, skilled cooks and first-aid backup
4x4 jeep transfer to Sassi and return pickup confirmed
cons: No pricing published; cost only on request
No itemised inclusions/exclusions section on the page
Meal coverage vague (mentions hot dinner/warm meals, no breakdown)
Starts at Gilgit; Islamabad transport not addressed
verdict: A blog-style 7-day itinerary with the most realistic lake altitude (~3,310m) and a relaxed pace, but it publishes no price, no itemised inclusions, and only vague meal details.
excludes: Not itemised on the page; costs and inclusions (porters, meals, transport) quoted only on contacting the operator directly.
